context: A student asks the teacher to explain the news
purpose: Explain economics simply; teach 輸出/工業/大幅/と共に/停止/崩壊/ミサイル/基地

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、ニュースが難しくて。輸出って何ですか？
lines.en: Teacher, the news is hard. What is exporting?
lines.style: earnest teen asking basics, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国内で作った工業製品を、外国に売ることです。
lines.en: Selling domestically made industrial goods abroad.
lines.style: teacher defining plainly, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 売上が大幅に増えると、いいことですか？
lines.en: Is a sharp sales rise a good thing?
lines.style: teen following up simply, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。ただ、技術の進歩と共に競争も激しくなります。
lines.en: Yes. But along with tech progress, competition intensifies.
lines.style: teacher adding nuance, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 工場が停止したら、どうなるんですか？
lines.en: What happens if a factory halts?
lines.style: curious teen probing consequences, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 失業者が増えます。社会の崩壊を防ぐ政策が要ります。
lines.en: Unemployment rises. Policy is needed to prevent social collapse.
lines.style: teacher explaining the ripple, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ミサイルや基地の話は、別の問題ですよね。
lines.en: Missiles and bases are a separate issue, right?
lines.style: teen distinguishing topics, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、安全保障の領域です。
lines.style: teacher confirming the distinction, each word carrying genuine natural feeling
